messages.content: Ni hao, selamat pagi. Saya Encik Lee Hui Min, Support Operations Lead dari Shopee MY Customer Service team. Hari ni saya nak ingest satu email customer complaint yang masuk pukul 9 pagi tadi — subject 'Refund tak masuk 3 weeks already', from cust.lim.wj@gmail.com, mailbox `support@shopee.com.my`. Boleh start dengan ingest dulu?
Ni hao, selamat pagi Encik Lee Hui Min. Baik, saya inisialisasi ingestion email tersebut.

messages.content: {"error": {"http_status": 413, "code": "payload_too_large", "message": "Attachment exceeds inline size limit (12.4 MB > 10 MB). Use streaming upload via ingest_incoming_email_stream or split attachments.", "trace_id": "trc-413-2026-05-21-09-01-22-aa", "suggestion": "Use 'attachment_refs' (external upload) instead of inline."}}

Maaf Encik Lee, API tolak permintaan dengan **HTTP 413 Payload Too Large**:

- **Masalah:** Attachment 12.4 MB melebihi had inline 10 MB.
- **Cadangan sistem:** Gunakan `attachment_refs` (external upload reference) dan bukan inline payload.
- **Trace ID:** `trc-413-2026-05-21-09-01-22-aa`

Saya cadang Encik upload attachment dahulu ke object store, kemudian retry dengan reference. Adakah Encik mahu lihat attachment sebenar dulu atau skip attachment buat sementara waktu?
Ai yaa, customer hantar screenshot sangat besar la. Skip attachment dulu, ingest body sahaja — kita request attachment semula dari customer kemudian if needed.
Baik Encik, retry tanpa attachment.
